# litllm

The goal of `litllm` is to help you mine pdfs for scholarly analysis.

## Installation

You can install the development version of litllm from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("avahoffman/litllm")
```

## Getting Started

Please follow along with the vignette to learn how to use this package:

<https://www.avahoffman.com/litllm/articles/getting_started.html>

Please let us know about any bugs or suggestions via [GitHub
issues](https://github.com/avahoffman/litllm/issues).

# Package index

## All functions

- [`ll_check_api_key()`](http://www.avahoffman.com/litllm/reference/ll_check_api_key.md)
  : Check for the OpenAI API Key.
- [`ll_check_connection()`](http://www.avahoffman.com/litllm/reference/ll_check_connection.md)
  : Check for internet connection.
- [`ll_check_file_structure()`](http://www.avahoffman.com/litllm/reference/ll_check_file_structure.md)
  : Check if provided value is a file or a directory and return files.
- [`ll_clean_authors()`](http://www.avahoffman.com/litllm/reference/ll_clean_authors.md)
  : Clean up authors and title from ll_query-type output.
- [`ll_clean_journals()`](http://www.avahoffman.com/litllm/reference/ll_clean_journals.md)
  : Clean up title, year, and journal from ll_query-type output.
- [`ll_clean_references()`](http://www.avahoffman.com/litllm/reference/ll_clean_references.md)
  : Clean up title, year, and journal from ll_query-type output.
- [`ll_extract_authors()`](http://www.avahoffman.com/litllm/reference/ll_extract_authors.md)
  : Mine ChatGPT for pdf metadata: Title, Authors, and Institutions.
- [`ll_extract_journals()`](http://www.avahoffman.com/litllm/reference/ll_extract_journals.md)
  : Mine ChatGPT for pdf metadata: Title, Year, and Journal.
- [`ll_extract_references()`](http://www.avahoffman.com/litllm/reference/ll_extract_references.md)
  : Mine ChatGPT for pdf metadata: works cited information.
- [`ll_find_institution_type()`](http://www.avahoffman.com/litllm/reference/ll_find_institution_type.md)
  : Perform logical checks on a vector of institutions using ChatGPT.
- [`ll_journal_corrections()`](http://www.avahoffman.com/litllm/reference/ll_journal_corrections.md)
  : Clean up / Remove some journal specific stuff.
- [`ll_pull_institutions()`](http://www.avahoffman.com/litllm/reference/ll_pull_institutions.md)
  : Extract "Institutions" from a messy vector using ChatGPT.
- [`ll_query()`](http://www.avahoffman.com/litllm/reference/ll_query.md)
  : Perform a query against OpenAI's API.
